LESSON PLAN CRE ACTIVITES
 Week: Lesson:
 SCHOOL GRADE DATE TIME ROLL
 TWO
STRAND/THEME/TOPIC: CHRISTIAN VALUES
SUBSTRAND/SUB-THEME/SUB-TOPIC: SHARING.
Specific lesson learning outcome.
By the end of the lesson, the learner should be to identify items shared at school to promote harmonious living.
KEY INQUIRY QUESTION (s)
 What items can we share?
 Core competencies Values PCIs
  Critical thinking  Respect Self-awareness
  Problem solving  Responsibility Self-esteem
  self-awareness  Sharing
  Decision making  Unity
LEARNING RESOURCES
Bible.
C.R.E activities Learner’s Book Grade 2 pg. 82-85.
C.R.E Activities Teacher’s Guide Grade 2 pg. 50-51.
ORGANIZATION OF LEARNING
Learners to work in pairs or groups.
INTRODUCTION
Learners to sing a familiar song.
LESSON DEVELOPMENT (Assessment as learning)
 Step 1: Learners to Read Hebrews 13:16.
 Step 2: Guide learners to identify various items that can be shared at school.
 Step 3: Guide learners in pairs or groups to list the importance of sharing with others.
SUMMARY
We should share.
CONCLUSION (Assessment of Learning)
Learners to recite Hebrews 13:16
EXTENSION OF ACTIVITIES
Learners to participate in community activities e.g. sharing with neighbours, sick.

 TWO

Specific lesson learning outcome.
By the end of the lesson, the learner should be to identify items shared at school to promote harmonious living and

 What items can we share?

Bible.
C.R.E activities Learner’s Book Grade 2 pg. 82-85.
C.R.E Activities Teacher’s Guide Grade 2 pg. 50-51.

Learners to work in pairs or groups.
INTRODUCTION
Learners to sing a familiar song.
LESSON DEVELOPMENT (Assessment as learning)

We should share.

STRAND/THEME/TOPIC: CHRISTIAN VALUES
SUBSTRAND/SUB-THEME/SUB-TOPIC: OBEDIENCE
Specific lesson learning outcome.
By the end of the lesson, the learner should be to obey teachers and the children’s government, to promote harmony in
the school.
KEY INQUIRY QUESTION (s)
 Why should we obey our parents and teachers?
 Core competencies Values PCIs
  Critical thinking  Respect Self-awareness
  Problem solving  Obedience Self-esteem
  self-awareness  Responsibility and love
  Decision making
LEARNING RESOURCES
Bible.
C.R.E activities Learner’s Book Grade 2 pg. 86-88.
C.R.E Activities Teacher’s Guide Grade 2 pg. 52-53.
ORGANIZATION OF LEARNING
Learners to work in pairs or groups.
INTRODUCTION
Learners to sing a familiar song.
LESSON DEVELOPMENT (Assessment as learning)
 Step 1: Learners to Read Hebrews 13:17.
 Step 2: Guide learners to discuss why they should obey teachers and children’s government.
 Step 3: Ask learners to share their experiences on obedience.
SUMMARY
We should share.
CONCLUSION (Assessment of Learning)
Learners to recite Hebrews 13:17
EXTENSION OF ACTIVITIES
Learners to visit senior citizen and listen to stories on the importance of obedience and the consequence of
 disobedience.

STRAND/THEME/TOPIC: CHRISTIAN VALUES
SUBSTRAND/SUB-THEME/SUB-TOPIC: HONESTY
Specific lesson learning outcome.
By the end of the lesson, the learner should be to explain reasons for telling the truth in their interaction with others.
KEY INQUIRY QUESTION (s)
 Why should we be honest?
 Core competencies Values PCIs
  Critical thinking  Honesty Self-awareness
  Problem solving  Trust Self-esteem
  self-awareness  Responsibility
  Decision making  Concern , care and
 integrity
LEARNING RESOURCES
Bible.
C.R.E activities Learner’s Book Grade 2 pg. 89-92.
C.R.E Activities Teacher’s Guide Grade 2 pg. 53-55.
ORGANIZATION OF LEARNING
Learners to work in pairs or groups.
INTRODUCTION
Learners to sing a familiar song.
LESSON DEVELOPMENT (Assessment as learning)
 Step 1: Learners to Read Proverbs 12:17-19.
 Step 2: Guide learners to discuss the conversation between James, Dennis and Teacher Moses on Page 89.
 Step 3: Ask learners to say why they should always tell the truth.
SUMMARY
We should be honest at all times.
CONCLUSION (Assessment of Learning)
Learners to recite Proverbs 12:19
EXTENSION OF ACTIVITIES
Learners to be given a task of collecting stories on honesty. They are to help others in the community in telling the
 truth.

Learners to work in pairs or groups.

Learners to sing a familiar song.

Learners to practice saying thank you whenever helped.

Learners to recite 1 Thessalonians 5:18.
EXTENSION OF ACTIVITIES
Learners to practice thankfulness at home and to other learners.

SUBSTRAND/SUB-THEME/SUB-TOPIC: FORGIVENESS
Specific lesson learning outcome.
By the end of the lesson, the learner should be to forgive others daily for peaceful co-existence.
KEY INQUIRY QUESTION (s)
 Why should we forgive?
 Core competencies Values PCIs
  Critical thinking  Forgiveness Self-awareness
  Problem solving  Humility Self-esteem
  self-awareness  Love
  Decision making  Tolerance, responsibility
 and unity
LEARNING RESOURCES
Bible.
C.R.E activities Learner’s Book Grade 2 pg. 95-97.
C.R.E Activities Teacher’s Guide Grade 2 pg. 57-59.
ORGANIZATION OF LEARNING
Learners to work in pairs or groups.
INTRODUCTION
Learners to sing a familiar song.
LESSON DEVELOPMENT (Assessment as learning)
 Step 1: Learners to discuss the story of the prodigal son in Luke 15:11-22.
 Step 2: Guide learners to watch a video on the prodigal son.
 Step 3: Guide learners to avoid annoying others daily in their lives.
SUMMARY
Learners to learn to forgive each other through kind words.
CONCLUSION (Assessment of Learning)
Learners to recite Matthew 18:21-22
EXTENSION OF ACTIVITIES
Learners to record occasions they forgive members of the family and friends in a week and learn to forgive always.

C.R.E activities Learner’s Book Grade 2 pg. 98-100.

ORGANIZATION OF LEARNING
Learners to work in pairs or groups.
INTRODUCTION
Learners to sing a familiar song.
LESSON DEVELOPMENT (Assessment as learning)
 Step 1: Learners to read Colossians 3:23.
 Step 2: Guide learners to display and count items they carry to school.
 Step 3: Guide learners to say the use of each item in relation to their studies.
SUMMARY
Everybody should be responsible.
CONCLUSION (Assessment of Learning)
Learners to recite Colossians 3:23
EXTENSION OF ACTIVITIES
Learners to interact with parents to provide what learners should carry to school.

 Step 4: Explain to the learners the importance of taking care of their stationery and possessions at school.
 Step 5: Learners to discuss why they should not forget school items at home.
 Step 6: Explain to the learners that responsibility cuts across other areas and guide them through the activities
 within the learner’s book.

Everybody should be responsible.
